changeSet.comment: OGC-1364: which results need review and how many sequential reviews, with a role per level. A policy without a lab unit is the lab-wide default.

changeSet.author: openelisglobal

preConditions.sqlCheck: select count(*) from clinlims.validation_policy where test_section_id is null

changeSet.comment: OGC-1364: the lab-wide default takes over "validate all results": true becomes All results with 1 review, anything else Only results that need review with 1 review, signed by the Validation role.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.validation_policy (id, test_section_id, review_trigger, review_levels, is_active, last_updated) SELECT nextval('clinlims.validation_policy_seq'), NULL, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.site_information WHERE name = 'validate all results' AND lower(trim(value)) = 'true') THEN 'ALL' ELSE 'NEEDS_REVIEW' END, 1, true, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP; INSERT INTO clinlims.validation_policy_level (validation_policy_id, level, role_id) SELECT p.id, 1, r.id FROM clinlims.validation_policy p JOIN clinlims.system_role r ON trim(r.name) = 'Validation' WHERE p.test_section_id IS NULL;
